caption: The drawing is executed in black ink on a light background and depicts a wrought and cast iron gate in a detailed, linear style. The main section shows a gate composed of multiple vertical iron bars, each bar adorned with ornate scrollwork and floral motifs at both the top and bottom, and topped with pointed finials. The gate is anchored to masonry on the sides and set above a paved sidewalk rendered with simple lines. In the upper left corner, there is an inset sketch showing the exterior of a two-story building with a porch and a fence, drawn with similar fine lines and cross-hatching for shading. The composition is labeled in the lower right as "WROUGHT and CAST IRON GATE," with the main focus on the gate's decorative ironwork and structure, and the inset providing architectural context. The entire image is monochromatic, with only black lines on a cream or off-white background.
title: Cast Iron Fence
